text: I think you'll enjoy the Three Packs and a Roast recipe, given your history of liking dishes with a Middle Eastern flair and featuring beef. Although this recipe's flavor profile is more American-inspired, the combination of the beef roast with the savory flavors of the ranch, Italian, and brown gravy mixes might appeal to you. Additionally, the recipe's cooking time is significantly longer than your average liked recipe, which could suggest that you're open to trying more complex or time-intensive dishes.
